title: Lost in Translation: Investigating Systematic Discrepancies between Parallel English and Chinese Names of American Chinese Restaurants
abstract: arXiv:2610.35191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/Engli

translated_title: 迷失在翻译中：调查美国中餐厅平行英文名称与中文名称之间的系统性差异
translated_abstract: 鉴于华人是移民美国历史最悠久的族群之一，中餐已成为美国餐饮界的核心组成部分，也为研究中国移民如何在文化上适应美国生活提供了一个有趣的视角。在此背景下，以往的研究主要聚焦于分析中餐厅所采用的英文名称，例如发现其使用了人们熟悉且典型的词汇。为了研究中国移民如何在不同社会、地理和人口环境下实现文化融入，本研究调查了美国中餐厅中文名称与英文名称之间尚未被充分探索的关系。具体而言，我们对在全美采样的3,172家中餐厅（占谷歌地图上总数的10%）开展了研究。我们提出了一个8维度的名称框架来捕捉名称背后的深层含义，并创建了包含884对经过标注的平行中英文名称的NameFrames数据集。
tldr: 本文提出8维度名称框架并构建NameFrames数据集，对美国3,172家中餐厅的中英文名称进行系统性对比，揭示了平行名称之间的差异，以探究华人移民在美国的文化融入情况。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an 8-dimension name frame and builds the NameFrames dataset to systematically investigate discrepancies between parallel Chinese and English names of 3,172 American Chinese restaurants, shedding light on the cultural adaptation of Chinese immigrants in the US.
